📰 ASML's Tin Droplet Revolution: Printing 2nm Chips

ASML's EUV lithography machines use vaporized tin droplets hit by lasers to generate 13.5nm light, enabling 2nm chip production. This breakthrough reshapes the semiconductor supply chain and defines the hardware ceiling for next-gen AI workloads.

📅 11 Oct 2026 | Source: ASML EUV Photolithography Engineering Whitepaper
